reproducibleNote: The Android ARM64 Cemu-as-adapter build is not yet byte-reproducible. This lock pins the upstream identity and records the adapter ABI contract; the multi-week core build (engines/build_native_adapter.sh) has not been implemented, so no artifactSha256/independentBuilds proof exists yet. The Java NativeAdapterCatalog stays fail-closed until a reproducible adapter with a signed hash ships.

toolchain.note: Pinned to match Lucent's other in-process engines; the exact NDK/CMake/Ninja artifact hashes will be recorded here once the reproducible adapter build is implemented.

cmakeOptions.note: Cemu is a standalone Vulkan emulator. The adapter target builds Cemu's core without its own Activity/UI and exports only lucent_native_adapter_entry; Lucent owns the surfaces, audio, input, and saves.

dependencies.note: Dependency closure stub. Cemu vendors its third-party libraries as git submodules (e.g. dependencies/, Externals/). Each submodule's repository/commit/archiveSha256 must be pinned here (mirroring engines/dolphin-source-lock.json) before the adapter build can claim a reproducible closure. Left empty deliberately: no dependency has been audited or pinned yet.
